# LDAK-KVIK parameters relevant to this pipeline

This file maps `nextflow_schema.json` parameters to the corresponding program behavior/CLI usage.

| Schema parameter | Program usage in pipeline |
|---|---|
| `run_assoc_kvik` | Workflow toggle for LDAK-KVIK association workflow. |
| `kvik_step1_optional` | Extra CLI flags appended to LDAK `--kvik-step1` command. |
| `kvik_step2_optional` | Extra CLI flags appended to LDAK `--kvik-step2` command. |
